title: Per-applicant reminder 428 not wired to the policy-reaccept gate its bulk sibling joins
evidence:
Bulk sibling IS listed inside the allowlist:
    ApiReturnedReminder(Error(e)) -> check(e)
The new sibling is absent and the allowlist falls through:
    ApiReturnedNotificationsRefresh(Error(e)) -> check(e)
    _ -> False
  }
}
The allowlist is consumed by the policy-gate refetch in update:
    should_refetch_session_for_policy_gate(
      was_modal_open,
      msg_triggered_policy_reaccept(msg),
    )
(grep of lines 391-438: 'ApplicantReminder' count = 0; 'ApiReturnedReminder(' present at offset 30.)
detail: ApiReturnedApplicantReminder is omitted from msg_triggered_policy_reaccept while the bulk ApiReturnedReminder is listed. A mid-session policy bump 428 from the new endpoint shows an error toast instead of surfacing the reaccept modal.
recommended_fix: Add `ApiReturnedApplicantReminder(Error(e)) -> check(e)` to msg_triggered_policy_reaccept in client/src/client.gleam, beside the existing ApiReturnedReminder arm.
